Text in the central column of lines 6-7 and the word "Pi-" at the foot is partly obscured; "Pi-" is the catchword. Passages with "jā", "ut", and "Rescripta" are as printed. Several words in the middle (e.g. "sibi subjecit", "Synodo") are doubtful and may be inaccurate.
